source_paper.title: Perturbing human V1 degrades the fidelity of visual working memory

evidence.locator: Figure 2A-C and Methods: behavioral analysis and EEG
evidence.supports: Paired TMS/no-TMS effects with 15 participants; uncertainty tests biological contrasts.

Historical reconstruction, participant-position limits and 15-versus16 source discrepancy are not improvement evidence.
Six original within-participant memory-error contrasts; source reports t, p and standardized d, while participant means and differences require source-data computation.

evidence.supports: Reaction-time and peak-velocity controls, original trial exclusions and source repeated-measures interpretation; nonsignificance is not equivalence.

evidence.locator: Results: radial/tangential saccade errors; Statistical analyses
evidence.supports: Within-person/condition z-scored OLS coefficients for radial and tangential contributions and their repeated-measures comparisons.

evidence.locator: Control Experiment 3; Results and Supplementary Figure 4A-B

target.description: TMS effects on spatial memory error, alpha lateralization and occipital alpha/beta responses.

dataset.description: Released experiment derivatives used by the author Figure 2B route: masterTFR_allsubs.mat; behavioral analysis uses the source memory task.

cohort.description: Figure 2 reports 15 paired participants. Released arrays contain 15 positions, but exact physical-person-to-position identity is not verified; the sample count alone does not authenticate the original cohort join.

split.description: Within-person TMS/no-TMS and phosphene-field conditions, not a model train/test partition.

inputs.description: Condition-specific EEG power derivatives and memory-guided behavioral responses.

preprocessing.description: The reviewed Figure 2B script selects 0.5-2 and 3-4.5 seconds and 7-20Hz by strict bounds before plotting; this derivative route cannot vary raw artifact removal.

metric.description: Paired behavioral-error and physiological contrasts; a larger contrast or smaller cluster p-value is not an accuracy score.

aggregation.description: Participant summaries and paired contrasts; the figure script also averages subjects for the topographic display.

full_panel.description: Original Figure 2A-C with all 15 paired participants: seven behavioral conditions and six memory-error contrasts; all four full alpha-lateralization topographies; original occipital time-frequency paired-cluster effects. Required companions include reaction time, peak velocity, radial/tangential error decomposition and its condition controls, the 10-person simulated-phosphene control, stimulated/opposite-V1 targeting specificity, pre-TMS/hemifield checks and post-pulse/ocular artifact support. Keep original participant/trial/condition/channel/frequency/time identities. Exact EEG cluster census, source numeric vectors and several control-input joins remain unresolved; the 12-region derivative is not the original cluster panel. Required non-scalar outputs are retained outside scalar findings: the complete radial/tangential repeated-measures ANOVA term/degree-of-freedom table; both original alpha and beta amplitude time-frequency arrays; the full positive/negative cluster statistics, corrected probabilities, labels and masks; complete pre-TMS, opposite-hemifield and post-pulse/ocular artifact control arrays with condition/support masks. Their source term/axis mappings and native verification remain unresolved. No whole array or table is represented by one scalar, and this partial scalar contract cannot establish full-panel reproduction.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions receive the same original paper and authorized complete source behavioral/EEG derivatives, coordinates, condition meanings and source cohort/control manifests. The author-code condition adds only the pinned official code. Do not expose evaluator targets, other-arm outputs or historical solver answers. Source published numbers remain known paper content and cannot count as execution evidence. Raw gaze, raw EEG, targeting measurements and source-data controls are admitted only when their authentic identity and original scope are verified; no synthetic replacement, changed windows, excluded participant or newly invented split.

blocking_issues: Physical-person-to-source-position identity is unverified; the 15 jointly ordered array positions and anonymous source roster are not an authenticated person join. The 10-person simulated-phosphene subset and targeting/control inputs also need source joins.

Original behavioral condition means, effect magnitudes, coefficient tables, numerical Figure2B vectors and complete Figure2C cluster outputs are not authenticated. Published t/p/d values are known inputs and cannot demonstrate computation.

Figure2B timing/frequency conflict is explicit: frozen improvement wording describes driver strict 0.5-2/3-4.5 s and 7-20 Hz masks, while create_topo ignores tidx/fidx and plots 8-12 Hz at 0.5-1.5/3-4 s. Preserve the anchor verbatim, but evaluate no substituted wider-window endpoint. Native nearest-bin and reduction parity is not qualified.

Manuscript trial-wise alpha-lateralization description and released helper mean-dB-then-ratio arithmetic must remain distinct until source-native reproduction scope is adjudicated. Source arithmetic is not silently replaced with stable or participant-wise formulas.

Original cluster_stats_TFR.m uses subj=16 and 32 design columns, contrary to 15 released/reported participants. Complete source-neighbor/channel definitions, actual cluster census, original randomness and a reviewed correction are required; fixed-region 12/36/540 statistics cannot replace Figure2C.

The original behavioral permutation recipe, reported tails and standardized d convention need source reconciliation. Existing helper signed means, participant sign flips/bootstrap and Holm correction are explicitly separate analyses, not exact publication p/d replay.

Raw gaze/EEG timing, exclusions, blink/ocular rejection, ICA and post-pulse artifact validity cannot be independently certified from the two released processed files alone; source masks and control provenance are missing.

All numeric tolerances and reproducibility uncertainty criteria remain unresolved. A printed p-value or nonsignificant comparison is neither an equivalence bound nor successful reproduction; no tolerance, confidence level or random seed is invented.

Source-native granular behavior, coefficient, field/mask and cluster outputs must be independently recomputed from authenticated inputs, linked to submitted analysis execution, and used to derive every final finding. Several original vector/term-to-scalar mappings remain unresolved and must be expanded before eligibility, not collapsed to the current placeholder.

No complete authenticated source-panel/data manifest, final evaluator/verification program or matched paper+data versus paper+data+author-code protocol with exposure/resource accounting is frozen. Admission policy is deliberately omitted rather than populated with invented SHA values.

Required ANOVA tables, alpha/beta amplitude maps, cluster outputs and EEG-control arrays are explicit full-panel obligations outside scalar findings. Their exact native term/axis mappings, authentic inputs and verification remain unresolved; neither omission nor one aggregate value can satisfy them. This partial scalar contract is not an eligible full-panel endpoint.
